Stale results ARE late-kept. Fix: journal LATE_RESULT_DISCARDED before the cancel_requested 409 too.

L3_host_service: E-L3-1 HIGH* (must-prove, joint L3+L6) UNTESTED combination: launcher-managed worker (inside launcher KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE job) + per-dispatch nested Job Object in _spawn_contained. If Windows refuses nested assignment, EVERY dispatch on real installs fails (ContainmentError->SPAWN_FAILED); harness sets COURIER_TEST_NO_JOB=1 (never tests it) and smoke submits zero tasks. REPRO: Windows box, real launcher (no TEST_NO_JOB), submit 1 synthetic task, expect COMPLETE. Either failure (fix: breakaway/nested handling or job-per-host design) or proof (close with run log).

E-L3-2 MEDIUM oversized artifacts crash the host process: collect_artifacts raises ContainmentError (bounds) inside _wait with no handler in iterate/run -> traceback + process exit; launcher respawns into the same poison task until max_attempts. Should report a non-retryable failure result instead.
E-L3-3 MEDIUM OutboxFull kills the host: _deliver_payload raises OutboxFull (cap 32) with no handler -> process exit. Should idle+retry (flush drains on next cycle).

E-L3-4 MEDIUM-LOW poison-400 liveness: deliver() raises ControllerError on persistent 400 -> entry stays in outbox forever, retried every cycle, fills toward OutboxFull. Need max-delivery-attempts + dead-letter/quarantine.

E-L3-5 MEDIUM-LOW _owner_alive uses bare PID (no create_time): dead owner + recycled PID -> orphan gate skips reaping (POSIX leak) / stale claim record; harness reads worker_pid from claim records -> taskkill could hit a recycled PID. Bind create_time at record write. (Check overlap with #159 continuity-cleanup-fence before implementing.)

E-L3-6 LOW-MEDIUM live stdio files unbounded: task .out/.err grow without rotation during a run (only tail-capped at read, 8-pair prune at next start). A chatty task fills disk. Quality bar requires rotation.
E-L3-7 LOW heartbeat-stop nuance + claim() maps every non-200 (incl 401 bad-token) to None = silent idle; auth misconfig looks like no-work. Log loudly on 401/403.
E-L3-8 LOW Windows dispatch kill has no graceful phase (straight TerminateJobObject; POSIX gets SIGTERM+grace). Task processes cannot flush on Windows timeout.
E-L3-9 LOW proc.wait() without timeout after _terminate_job (host.py); TerminateJobObject return ignored. Add bounded wait + ContainmentError.
E-L3-10 LOW pgid-reuse: POSIX group SIGKILL after root death can hit a recycled pgid (no member verification). Tiny window, catastrophic outcome. Track member PIDs or verify membership.

E-L3-11 INFO outbox/artifact paths embed raw dispatch_id (unsanitized) but all producers emit safe IDs (server uuid task-*/dsp-*); ExecutionSpec does not restrict charset -> relies on producer discipline. Defense-in-depth: sanitize like _claim_path.
